title: Hollywood Bowl with the symphony and upstaging Gregory Hines
summary: She won a standing ovation from 17,000 people, Gregory Hines snatched her flowers, and she says upstaged colleagues call her back anyway.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Hollywood Bowl performances with the symphony.

That went good. If I can’t get you one way, I can get you another. So, I got a standing ovation of 17,000 people. And Jeffery Hines, Gregory Hines, snatched the flowers out of my hand and ran off the stage.
I don’t know. I started to take my shoe and throw it.
[Did you] upstage Jeffery Hines and perhaps the symphony itself?
I think, yeah, them 17,000 people upstaged him. My ex-husband was there with two women and he was clapping.
It seems that you upstage just about anyone you perform on a bill with. How do you maintain a professional relationship with these people? Or do you just leave them behind?
Just leave them behind. They’ll call me again. Someone said, “I need her like Custer needed more Indians.”
